create_center_mask_scorer: create a CenterMaskScorer with a specific output type, width, and aggregation type for variant scoring
create_gene_mask_lfc_scorer: create a GeneMaskLFCScorer to quantify log fold change in gene expression between ALT and REF alleles
get_recommended_scorers: get the recommended variant scorers for a given organism from the RECOMMENDED_VARIANT_SCORERS dictionary
tidy_anndata: tidy an AnnData object containing variant scores into a long-format pandas DataFrame with metadata columns
tidy_scores: tidy a sequence of AnnData score objects into a single concatenated pandas DataFrame with one score per row
